findings.title: publish() permits DRAFT→PUBLISHED, bypassing required approval workflow
findings.evidence: Line 253: `if (existing.status !== "APPROVED" && existing.status !== "DRAFT")` — DRAFT is included in the allowed set, so a publisher can skip submit→review→approve and immediately publish a draft page.
findings.consequence: Any user with website.content.publish permission can make unapproved page content publicly visible, violating the spec Section 10.1 lifecycle (Draft → Submitted → Approved → Published) and plan step 3.4 (APPROVED→PUBLISHED only).
findings.correction: Change the guard to allow only APPROVED: `if (existing.status !== "APPROVED") { throw new BadRequestException(...) }`
